signal: Stampli raised a 61M Blackstone-led Series D and is moving beyond AP automation into AI-powered procure-to-pay in 2026.

email.body1:
Matthew, saw Stampli raised a 61M Series D and is pushing beyond AP into AI-powered procure-to-pay.

Expanding the product story that fast usually means more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Stampli off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matthew, quick follow-up for Stampli.

After a raise, the pipeline target usually jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Stampli needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matthew, last bit of proof for Stampli.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Stampli reply rate likely compares to other fintech platforms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matthew, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Stampli either way.
